# Library — AI access instructions

Website: https://squashberry.github.io/Read/
Source repository: https://github.com/squashberry/Read
Repository owner: squashberry
Repository name/path: /Read
Default branch: master

When asked to study or assess this library:
1. Inspect the repository's file listing first: https://api.github.com/repos/squashberry/Read/contents?ref=master
2. Pick the relevant uploaded PowerPoint, PDF or other source file.
3. Retrieve and inspect actual slide/page/document content before teaching. If direct content access fails, say exactly what could not be accessed and ask for the file to be attached or for an accessible text/PDF export.
4. Build lectures, study notes, flashcards, and exams from the actual material. Keep the source file name visible in the response. Clearly distinguish source information from supplementary explanations.
5. For nursing/clinical material, teach for education and remind the learner to verify clinical decisions against current institutional guidance.
6. Never claim to have opened, read or analysed a document unless you actually accessed its content.

The website is a static front end. Study buttons open ChatGPT with a prepared prompt; the site itself does not include an AI API key.
